title: Recursion with calls and a depth guard
summary: Proves a definition that calls itself other than in tail position: its internal function, with a depth parameter, by strong induction on a measure, and its entry function from one call at depth 0.
premises: For the internal function: its body keeps the store and returns f x, given Keeps for every argument with a smaller measure
For the entry: its body is one call of the internal function with the parameters and depth 0
result: Keeps for the internal function at every depth, and Implements for the entry.
